descriptors.definition: Before accepting an engagement to report on pro forma financial information included in a prospectus, the practitioner must evaluate competence, verify criteria suitability, and assess potential reporting obstacles. These checks ensure the compiled information remains reliable and avoids misleading intended users.
inclusion: Evaluation of practitioner capabilities and competence
Review of suitability of criteria and prevention of misleading information
Assessment of modified audit opinions on source or acquiree financial information
exclusion: Actual execution of substantive testing procedures
Drafting of the final assurance report
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from engagement planning because acceptance occurs prior to formal contract finalization and resource allocation.
source_ambiguities: The source text truncates abruptly at the end regarding acquiree historical financial information.

descriptors.concept_name: Documentation and Prospective Financial Information Reporting
descriptors.definition: Practitioners must maintain comprehensive working papers and documentation throughout assurance engagements governing pro forma and prospective financial data. Reports on prospective information require careful evaluation of underlying assumptions and management responsibilities.
inclusion: Working paper documentation for assurance engagements
Examination of evidence supporting prospective project assumptions
exclusion: Unverified casual drafting of assurance conclusions without evidence
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from pro forma compilation reporting because prospective information deals with future projections rather than historical adjustments.
source_ambiguities: The excerpt transitions abruptly into an integrated case scenario with draft report text containing an incomplete sentence ending.
